## Video Tutorial

{{< video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VkACnYfFgLE >}}

## Installation

Download the latest **Long Term Version** of QGIS [here](https://www.qgis.org/download/).

The most common issue with installing QGIS is for Mac users the first time you open up the program. You’ll often see an error message that says *“QGIS” can’t be opened because Apple cannot check it for malicious software.*

**You don’t need to worry about this message**; QGIS is trustworthy. If this happens, locate QGIS in Finder and right-click, then Open from that menu. That should resolve the problem.

![](images/open%20QGIS.png){width="287"}

## In this tutorial

Download shapefiles from the NYC Open Data Portal, open QGIS, save a QGIS project, and orient to the QGIS interface

**Timestamps (Click a link to start that segment in a new window)**

[0:00 - 1:17](https://youtu.be/VkACnYfFgLE?si=mGyUXktawbrOCFmT&t=24): Find and download subway stations (no longer available on NYC Open Data but you can download it [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/13kz4Ud11KQSGTi3H2PVC7Uw3sxsAch-6/view)) and [borough boundaries](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/City-Government/Borough-Boundaries/gthc-hcne) shapefiles

[1:17 - 3:34](https://youtu.be/VkACnYfFgLE?si=5sUnKectiwphdf29&t=77): Set up QGIS project folder with shapefiles and .QGZ file

[3:34 - 4:56](https://youtu.be/VkACnYfFgLE?si=b0_8ZzPdrLkFean9&t=214): QGIS user interface
